references.question: Looking at the title/cover page of every document across both case TCD 001/2024 and case CFI 016/2025, is there any party (claimant or defendant) common to both cases?
Is there a judge who presided over both case ARB 034/2025 and case CFI 067/2025?
Identify whether any person or company is a main party to both ENF 269/2023 and SCT 514/2025.
Review the full case files for DEC 001/2025 and TCD 001/2024 — did any judge preside over proceedings in both cases?
Does the DIFC law numbered DIFC Law No. 7 of 2018 deal with insolvency and preferential debts?
According to Article 13 of the Employment Law 2019, can an Employer employ a child who is under sixteen years of age?
What is the effective date for due diligence requirements for Pre-existing Accounts and New Accounts under the Common Reporting Standard Law 2018?
references.answer: Pre-existing Accounts: 31 December 2016; New Accounts: 1 January 2017.

references.question: Under the Operating Law - DIFC Law No. 7 of 2018, who is responsible for appointing and dismissing the Registrar?
references.answer: The Board of Directors of the DIFCA appoints and may dismiss the Registrar, after consulting the President.

references.question: Looking only at the last page of the document in case SCT 514/2025, what was the outcome of the specific order or application described?
references.answer: The Defendant's Application for Permission to Appeal was refused.

references.question: What was the result of the application heard in case SCT 169/2025?
references.answer: The Permission to Appeal Application was refused, the adjournment request was refused, and there was no order as to costs.

references.question: According to the 'IT IS HEREBY ORDERED THAT' section of arbitration case ARB 034/2025, what did the court decide?
references.answer: The ASI Order was discharged, the Defendant's Set Aside Application was granted, and the Claimant was ordered to pay the Defendant's costs, with a costs statement due within 5 days.

references.question: What does Article 16(1)(c) of the Employment Law 2019 require an Employer to keep records of regarding an Employee's remuneration?
references.answer: The employee's remuneration, gross and net where applicable, and the applicable pay period.
